Products

Saif Seas has built a life saving buoy with remote control for beach safety. It was indigenously engineered for drowning safety in a record time of 11 months.

  • ADVANCED
  • EASY TO USE
  • CONVENIENT

100% AUTOMATEDLONG-DISTANCE RESCUES FOR VARIED MISSIONS

100% AUTOMATED
Unmanned remote controlled rescue with no risk to human life in the rescue process

LONG RANGE COMMUNICATION
Strong 3km communication, extendable upto 10 km on request

CUSTOMISABLE FOR MISSIONS
Fit it with HD cameras, robotic probes or weaponry and design the drone for the job

SIMPLE OPERATIONNO TRAINING NEEDED

DEPLOYED IN SECONDS
Just switch it on and throw it into action

LIGHTWEIGHT
At just 12 kg on the scale, it is easy to handle and deploy

HASSLE-FREEENGINEERED FOR CONVENIENCE

LONG LASTING BATTERY
90 mins on moderate load and 8 hours of GPS tracking

SUPERFAST CHARGING
Only 2 hours needed for full charge

LOW MAINTENANCE
Self diagnostic software for easy troubleshooting and rectification

About

Vision: To Democratize robotics and automation in the marine space to build better lives for mankind
Mission: To build cutting edge products that solve today’s problems that are globally competent and locally relevant

The Team: Technical excellence, business acumen and visionary leadership

  • Ahmed
    Shaikh Abdeally

     Founder | Inspiration and Motivator
    BSc(H) | Age: 87 yrs | Exp: 70 yrs
     
    Having immersed myself into building businesses for the last 6 decades, I now help others do the same. I am helping my sons take the best course towards changing the status quo of marine innovation.

  • Taher
    Calcuttawala

     Co-Founder | Chief Operating Officer
     
    I am a textbook businessman and am fortunate to have had the opportunity to take my father’s humble business into a multi–location organization. Mastering the supply business in shipping, offshore and dredging industry and creating sustainable growth are my constant goals.

  • Aliasgar
    Calcuttawala

     Co-Founder | Chief Technical Officer
     
    A post graduate in Mechatronics from the University of Siegen, Germany. With over ten years of research and experience in this field and my business background, I feel I was destined to bring innovation to the marine cause. With my robotic rescue craft or the water drone, I am confident to bring value and change lives in this sector.
